item.title: Toyosu Market — Guide
item.description: Toyosu Market, on a reclaimed island in Tokyo Bay, is the huge modern wholesale market that took over from the legendary Tsukiji inner market in 2018, and is now one of the largest fish and seafood markets in the world. Housed in vast, clean, climate-controlled buildings, it handles an enormous volume of seafood and produce. For visitors, the star attraction is the chance to watch the famous pre-dawn tuna auctions — where huge frozen tuna are sold amid rapid bidding — viewed from dedicated observation windows and decks (a limited number can watch from a closer ground-level area by advance application).
